Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12476, whose subject line describes relating to the Presidential Commission on the Conduct of United States-Japan Relations. Section 2 rewrites section 2(c) so that the Commission, in connection with its participation in the United States-Japan Advisory Commission, may conduct studies, hearings and meetings, assemble and disseminate information, and issue reports and other publications. Whether the end of the Commission’s life extinguished this power is not shown by a held source, so the first held end of this clause is the revocation. No earlier express end was found.

Terminated by its own terms. Section 3 rewrites section 4(b) of Executive Order 12421 to provide that, in accordance with the Federal Advisory Committee Act, the Commission terminates on October 31, 1984, unless sooner extended. The stated day is recorded inclusively, so the first end is dated 1984-10-31; on the exclusive reading the end falls on 1984-10-30, disclosed for the reviewer (owner ruling 2026-10-21, until-dates). No extension is held: a number search of the held Federal Register order texts (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts) for the parent order 12421 found citations only in Executive Orders 12476 and 12534. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 later revoked this order by number (the table lists 12476, whose subject line describes relating to the Presidential Commission on the Conduct of United States-Japan Relations); it is a later event because the clause had already ended. No earlier end was found.

research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register printing of Executive Order 12476 (49 FR 20473, Federal Register of May 15, 1984; govinfo PDF text layer, grade original_representation_unverified, recorded as acceptable as original), headed Presidential Commission on the Conduct of United States-Japan Relations and signed May 11, 1984. It renames the advisory group the Commission works with, rewrites the Commission’s powers and sets its termination date. Inventory: the lead-in and sections 1 to 3, each recorded as one clause and confirmed against the full held text. Ending: Section 3 ended on its own sunset (1984-10-31, inclusive); the lead-in and sections 1 and 2 end on EO 12553 (1986-02-25), so the whole-order end is the later date. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12476, whose subject line describes relating to the Presidential Commission on the Conduct of United States-Japan Relations. Executive Order 12534 of September 30, 1985 (held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12534.txt; not among this packet’s citable evidence) revokes the parent order 12421 but does not name this order; under owner ruling 2026-10-21 (unnamed instruments) it is a disclosed candidate earlier end for the reviewer and not an end, and it is not recorded as a later event.  The packet’s number-citation lookup over the held order texts (33,118 readable files) found no held text citing this order by number other than its own printings. Searches: the OFR executive-order catalog search and the USC and eCFR citation searches were selected after reading their coverage notes (complete; no coverage warning; the USC edition runs through 2026-10-09 and the eCFR search to 2026-10-14, which cannot matter for an order whose end is shown in 1986 or earlier).
